1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1244|e492be56.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|e492be56.text:
<Rethiel takes the Rotheap Innards from you.>

It is worse than I thought. The dark presence deep beneath us seethes with a malevolence that has seeped into the very fibers of life within the wetlands.

For now, I fear all we can do is combat its symptoms. Provide relief to the land and those who rely on it where we can.

Meanwhile, we must continue to look for the source. It roils... whispers just under the veil of the sounds of night.

Take this, as a token of my gratitude. May it help you further combat this madness.

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1976|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

270637|3e0b4d08.name: Howin Kindfeather
270637|3e0b4d08.text: So many Wildhammer lives lost... whole families erased...

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5491|08830bac.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

5491|837f02f9.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

269-progress.name: Bishop Farthing
269-progress.text: Rest, brother.  I can tell you have traveled far, and you bear a heavy burden.  Can you tell me what casts that dark shadow over you?
269-progress.title: Seeking Wisdom

293-progress.name: Archbishop Benedictus
293-progress.text: What is that orb you have? It looks...soiled.
293-progress.title: Cleansing the Eye

322-progress.name: Grimand Elmore
322-progress.text: How might I ply my craft for you, $c?
322-progress.title: Blessed Arm

324-progress.name: Glorin Steelbrow
324-progress.text: Did you find the lightforge iron you need?
324-progress.title: The Lost Ingots

325-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
325-progress.text: Hello, $N.  You haven't been gone that long, but I see a fire in your eyes I did not see before.
325-progress.title: Armed and Ready

91905-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91905-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91905-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91905-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91905-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91905-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

98189-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
98189-progress.text: What's that you've got there? Let me take a look.
98189-progress.title: Return the Statuette

98190-progress.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98190-progress.text: Let us speak, $c. I can feel you carry something of the Light.
98190-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-complete.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-complete.text:
By the Light... it looks just like his boy...

<Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker pauses for a moment.>

This statuette has indeed been blessed. Its connection to Terenas, its survival of what that monster did to him... this carries great power for those who believe in its strength.

It is best kept here for now, under guard of the $c order. We will meditate on it further to learn more of its gifts, and perhaps it may aid us in dark times ahead.

Thank you, $c. Light bless you.
98191-complete.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-progress.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-progress.text: Light be with you, $c. You are clearly not here for small talk--what is it?
98191-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98197-progress.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-progress.text: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!
98197-progress.title: Spoils of War

98208-progress.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-progress.text: Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.
98208-progress.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98209-progress.text: I welcome you to Auberdine, $c. How may we be of aid to you in your travels?
98209-progress.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98246-progress.name: Howin Kindfeather
98246-progress.text: The Razormaw won't be none too happy about you taking their eggs, so be ready for a squabble.
98246-progress.title: Trying Times
